dataset.dedup: exact SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text, global across all sources and splits
dataset.split_rule: u = first 8 bytes of sha256(f'{seed}:' + text) / 2**64; val if u < val_fraction, test if u < val_fraction + test_fraction, else train; per-source byte budgets per split, documents landing in a full split are dropped

meta.lm_architecture: pre-LayerNorm causal Transformer (torch TransformerEncoderLayer: ReLU FFN, biases), no positional encoding of any kind (NoPE: order comes only from the causal mask), tied input/output embeddings

pool.rule: train split of the dataset below minus every base train/val/test document (sha256)
